title: TweenService:Create()
summary: Builds a Tween object for an instance: which properties move toward which goal values, over what duration and easing curve. Returns the Tween — remember to :Play() it.

reference.signature: TweenService:Create(instance: Instance, tweenInfo: TweenInfo, goal: { [string]: any }) --> Tween

parameters.name: instance
parameters.description: The object whose properties will animate.

parameters.name: tweenInfo
parameters.description: TweenInfo.new(time, easingStyle, easingDirection, repeatCount, reverses, delayTime).

parameters.name: goal
parameters.description: Map of property name → target value. Names must be real properties of the instance with tweenable types.

reference.returns: A Tween object: Play(), Pause(), Cancel(), Completed event. Creation does NOT start playback.

explanation.whatItIs: The planning step: describe the destination and the journey; you get a reusable player object back.
explanation.whyItExists: Separating definition from playback lets you configure, replay, and cancel animations cleanly.
whenToUse: Before every tween: Create → configure → Play
whenNotToUse: Expecting Create alone to animate — it doesn't
tips: Keep the Tween object if you need to Cancel or await Completed
Recreating per-play is fine for changing goals
commonMistakes: Goal property typos → 'property is not a member' error
Non-tweenable property types in the goal

examples.title: Create and play
examples.code:
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local info = TweenInfo.new(
    0.5,                                -- duration
    Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,
    Enum.EasingDirection.Out
)

local tween = TweenService:Create(part, info, {
    Transparency = 1,
    Size = part.Size * 2,
})

tween:Play()
tween.Completed:Wait()   -- yields until done (inside a coroutine/Event)
